card.name: Sentence ends before an explanation follows
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or punctuation mark that closes a short, punchy opening statement in general web prose, right before the author elaborates or turns to a contrast. It is not found in drug-label text.

card.writes: Weakly favors rhetorical connectives like 'somehow' and '何况' and discourages causal openers like '由于', so it shapes how the next clause is framed.
card.plain: It marks the point in an essay where a short hook sentence ends and the writer is about to explain or counter it.
